"""Sentinel-generated confirming test for INC-75425e5d (payments).

Hypothesis: POST /pay is spending most of its time in the payment gateway timeout/retry path: timed-out upstream calls are retried up to 3 times, and each slow attempt burns the full 50ms timeout before failing. The observed ~150ms slow requests line up with repeated gateway timeouts, while fraud and telemetry code do not explain the latency pattern.
"""
import statistics
import time
import tracemalloc

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from payments.app import app

client = TestClient(app)


def _call(method, url, body):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    response = client.request(method, url, content=body or None, headers={"content-type": "application/json"})
    return response, (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000


REQUEST = ('POST', '/pay', '{"email":"user198@shop.example","amount":195.96}')
BUDGET_P50_MS = 14.3  # pre-incident p50 4.27 ms, with margin
BUDGET_P95_MS = 110.4  # pre-incident p95 55.22 ms, with margin


def test_incident_request_stays_within_latency_budget():
    _call(*REQUEST)  # warm-up
    timings = sorted(_call(*REQUEST)[1] for _ in range(20))
    assert statistics.median(timings) <= BUDGET_P50_MS, timings
    assert timings[18] <= BUDGET_P95_MS, timings
